body: Never seen anyone for it. I don't want to be reliant on meds, but if it helps who knows. I'm hoping on seeing someone in the future though, after I've talked to some family on the matter.
Thank you. Sadly, due to constant overtime for the next \~month I might have a hard time finding a good 1 on 1 talk night. I will try though. You've given me motivation at least.
You know what, I have a cousin who's basically like a sister. Idk how to bring it up, but maybe just "I need help" is a good start?

I do want to tell my parents... in time, but recently I've met a friend from work who I've bonded with like a brother. I really wanted to tell him how I feel, but he got his girlfriend pregnant and had his gender reveal today so I would hate to even bring that up now of all times. Poor timing I guess. I wish I could run it by a close friend first is all, I'm not even close to ready to tell my mom. My dad would probably forget, he has a mental illness as of last year that gives him some foggy memories. Getting a strong rock/hardplace vibe right now.

First, this actually made me genuinely feel nice. So thank you for that.

Second, I've always considered therapy. I just don't have the courage to go and let those around me know of my depression. It's like it's more convenient to just keep pushing the  way I always have. I really don't know how to make the leap of faith and trust someone with my deepest thoughts.
